posts.text:
My NFL Today’s Picks (Week 5 – 2026 Season)

Well this NFL season has gotten wild for strange reasons. The ref show has gotten out of hand at least within the last week. 2 referees have been suspended for there unexpected conducted. Plus it didn’t seemed like a big deal on the incidents. However, I think they may have missed one like in the Cardinals-Giants game when a side judge used some colorful language towards a Cardinals player. As of now, no word has come of it up to this point. By the way On-Field officials just like the Feds watch song, the league is watching and taking notice. J.J. McCarthy is now on the Giants, after an unexpected trade from the Vikings earlier this week. I guess Kyler Murray is going to be the Vikings starting quarterback for now. The Los Angeles Chargers are now 0-4 and most hope is lost already on the season for them. The biggest question will be is will they win a game, I hope so but they can forget about the playoffs. Back in 1992, the San Diego Chargers started the season 0-4 and made it a dramatic turnaround and went to the playoffs by winning 11 of there last 12 games to even win the AFC Western Division. As they had to hold off both Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs to win the Division. So it is not totally out of the question, but it will be a tough one the rest of the season for the L.A. Chargers. Well as for my picks to start the month of October. The month started great in Week 4 I went 12-4. So far on the 2026 season, I am 38-26 and there is plenty of more football coming. So it is now time for my latest installment of my NFL picks:Thursday Night Football on Amazon Prime Video: (Kickoff after 8:00pmEDT)Tampa Bay Buccaneers over Dallas CowboysEarly Sunday Morning Football on NFL Network: (Kickoff @ 9:30amEDT)Philadelphia Eagles over Jacksonville Jaguars *Game in London, England*Early Sunday Afternoon Kickoff: (Games @ 1:00pmEDT)*Games on CBS Sports*Houston Texans over Tennessee TitansLas Vegas Raiders over New England PatriotsCleveland Browns over New York JetsPittsburgh Steelers over Indianapolis Colts*Games on FOX Sports*Green Bay Packers over Chicago BearsCincinnati Bengals over Miami DolphinsMinnesota Vikings over New Orleans SaintsNew York Giants over Washington CommandersLate Sunday Afternoon Kickoff: (Games @ 4:00pm or Later)Denver Broncos over Los Angeles Chargers (Game on CBS Sports)Detroit Lions over Arizona Cardinals (Game on FOX Sports)Seattle Seahawks over San Francisco 49ers (Game on FOX Sports)Sunday Night Football on NBC and Peacock: (Kickoff after 8:00pmEDT)Baltimore Ravens over Atlanta FalconsMonday Night Football on ESPN and ABC: (Kickoff after 8:00pmEDT)Los Angeles Rams over Buffalo BillsThere you have it as my NFL Picks are up, and on the board for your viewing pleasure. So let’s enjoy this weekend’s football action!

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. app.bsky.feed.searchPosts is HTTP 403 for this project (re-measured 2026-09-18 from the CI runner and from an independent client IP). Unauthenticated Bluesky search is therefore unavailable; discovery comes from Google News and from the verified handles this project follows directly (app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, which does work).
